fusions.name: Linked Arms
fusions.desc: Whips a length of links into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that each. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Swing In
fusions.desc: Swings you on the links to a target up to 7 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold Still
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, and you finish 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Short Leash
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
